findings.problem: The hint "go and get something for someone" describes holen (to fetch) just as well, so "Ich hole dir..." is also a right answer and the prompt has two answers.
findings.fix: hint: get hold of something, often by buying it, for someone; not holen (fetch) or bekommen

back.target: to get (hold of), to obtain, to buy (something for someone)
back.example: I'll get you a ticket tomorrow.

note: besorgen also means to worry someone, but that sense is rare; the card's other prompt (worried) is the adjective besorgt, so it does not clash with this card.
